context: Tests the ticket-linked troubleshooting rules: slug prefix and the Jira Comment Draft section.

checklist.name: Loaded the troubleshooting schema
checklist.description: The agent reads troubleshooting.yaml in full before generating the entry.

checklist.name: Slug prefixed with the lowercase ticket key
checklist.description: The filename is `2026-04-07-proj-1234-<slug>.md` with the ticket key in lowercase as the prefix.

checklist.name: Ticket key not repeated in the slug
checklist.description: The key appears only once in the filename, as the prefix.

checklist.name: Jira Comment Draft section present
checklist.description: The entry has a `## Jira Comment Draft` section.

checklist.name: Draft banner present
checklist.description: The section starts with a `Draft for PROJ-1234 - review before posting; not yet posted.` style banner.

checklist.name: Comment is self-contained
checklist.description: The draft stands on its own for a ticket reader who has not seen the journal entry.

checklist.name: Nothing posted to the tracker
checklist.description: The agent does not post the comment to Jira.

checklist.name: Validation run and passing
checklist.description: The agent runs the validator and it passes before any commit.
